newsitem.title: USA: Optical Sensors cuts Q4, full-year loss.
newsitem.headline: Optical Sensors cuts Q4, full-year loss.

text.p: Optical Sensors Inc, a development stage company, said Wednesday it narrowed its losses for the 1996 fourth quarter and full year.
President Sam Humphries said results "were in line with our expectations."
The company said it has released its new OpticalCAM Blood Measurement System for commercial sale.
It also said its SensiCath Sensor is in production. The device provides readings in 60 seconds without depleting the patient's blood supply and without exposure to potentially infectious blood.
Humphries said in a statement Optical Sensors now was positioned "with technology and available products to serve a very large market."
For the fourth quarter, the company posted a loss of $0.29 per share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.66. For the full year, it incurred a loss of $1.30 compared to a 1995 loss of $2.70.
